name: gui_folded_pass_edit
description: GL-5a, from File > New Project > Blank with Studio's GUI only. On the Graph tab the rendering section's present is a folded node whose summary says it is edited here (decision 1). Picked, the column beside the canvas holds the Pass Editor's parts for it (decision 2): its Fragment is picked from the list -- engine://shader_lab_hello in place of engine://passthrough -- and that is one edit_preset_pass the engine takes: the root holds the new fragment and the picture changes. The Graph tab's Undo takes it back through the render edit history (RU-1): the root holds engine://passthrough and the picture is the one before. Last, the pass's Serial box in the column (decision 5) writes edit_target_planning: the root's target_planning holds it, the box stays on, and the Frame Plan reads the decision in the plan it shows. Typed: the project folder and name in New Project.
